verdict.rationale: Crossmint is agentic-commerce and checkout infrastructure, so merchant-side controls over agent access are a fair question. However, its documented controls all sit on the buyer side: user-defined spending rules, allowed counterparties, and merchant locking on order intents. Nothing in the evidence shows a merchant rate-limiting, allowlisting, or denying specific agents or agent platforms on its catalog or checkout; client-side key URL whitelisting is an API-key security measure, not agent access control.
